question: Among the electrode manufacturing technologies and cell chemistries for high-energy lithium-ion batteries whose improvements are estimated, which has the largest estimated energy density improvement?
expect: Section 9, ultra-high-speed (thick) electrode processing: 325–350 Wh/kg (p10.T1 r12)
rendered: According to Table 1, Section 9 – Ultra-High-Speed (Thick) Electrode Processing has the largest estimated energy density improvement, which is 325-350 Wh/kg.

prompt.system: You answer questions about one document, "Perspectives on the relationship between materials chemistry and roll-to-roll electrode manufacturing for high-energy lithium-ion batteries", using only what that document contains. It is below, condensed: page by page, the sentences that state a value, with the few other sentences that best match the question (the rest are left out), then its tables row by row and facts read from its figures. Answer briefly. If you compute a number, show the calculation. If the question assumes something the document contradicts, say so. If the document does not hold the answer, say so.
